new_learnings.text: Post-crash index bounce with weak breadth (0.93:1 despite indices +3-7%) is a false signal: 国家队/机构 buying index heavyweights lifts headline numbers but market internals remain weak until deleveraging completes. Do not enter until breadth crosses above 1.5:1.
new_learnings.mechanism: 国家队 buys ETFs/index heavyweights → indices rise, but underlying stocks are still in forced-selling mode from 融资 deleveraging → breadth divergence. The divergence resolves when forced selling exhausts, typically 1-3 days after policy intervention.

new_learnings.text: IV Rank at 100% (all ETFs) historically marks a good medium-term entry zone but the V2 buy gate correctly blocks entries until breadth confirms. 'Right but early' in a momentum system = wrong. Wait for breadth to turn before deploying into extreme IV.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extreme IV = market pricing massive 2-way risk. Entering without breadth confirmation is gambling on bounce direction rather than riding confirmed momentum.

new_learnings.text: 凯莱英 (002821) has the cleanest MA structure in the entire candidate pool: dist_ma20 still positive at +5.3% after the crash, meaning the medium-term trend survived. When breadth confirms, stocks holding above MA20 through a systemic sell-off should be first entries — they show relative strength that attracts institutional buying first in recovery.
new_learnings.mechanism: Institutions rotate into relative-strength names first when re-entering after a crash. Stocks above MA20 post-crash have demonstrated demand absorption during the selling.

new_learnings.text: 融资 deleveraging signal is pervasive (18/28 candidates show 'deleveraging') — this confirms a macro deleveraging cycle rather than stock-specific risk. When the signal is universal, it loses stock-level differentiation value. Use it to confirm regime (we're in deleveraging) rather than to filter individual names.
new_learnings.mechanism: During systemic deleveraging, margin reduction is forced/mechanical rather than discretionary — even strong stocks see 融资 outflows as leveraged holders are compelled to reduce risk regardless of fundamentals.

market_summary: Post-crash relief bounce: 科创50 +6.94%, 创业板 +5.20% after -22% crash. Breadth 0.93:1 bearish divergence — more stocks down than up despite green indices, confirming the bounce is concentrated in index heavyweights via 国家队 buying. IV Rank 100% across all ETFs (extreme fear). 融资余额 11-day decline, deleveraging cycle may be nearing end. 涨停46/跌停24. Policy support (央企增持, 稳市场座谈会) providing floor but recovery not yet confirmed by breadth. Buy gate NOT met — all cash, waiting for breadth >1.5:1.
